Thanks for the flag. A few finance checks and recommendations:

- Required for payee creation and ACH enablement: valid W-9 with matching EIN, proof of bank account (voided check or bank letter), and an authorized signer (name + title). We have the W-9 and bank sheet, but the W-9 shows the legal name "ApparaLedger, LLC" while the invoices we expect will likely show the DBA.

- Recommended approach: create the primary payee as the legal entity (ApparaLedger, LLC) in the ledger and add an alias "ApparaLedger Solutions" so PO text matching doesn't fail. That keeps tax/legal data clean while letting procurement route POs to the DBA.

- Please ask vendor for a short confirmation email from an authorized signer that the DBA is a legitimate alias and that they accept PO issuance under either name. If they can update the W-9 to include the DBA line that would be ideal but not mandatory.

- For immediate PO routing, we can whitelist procure@apparaledger.com as the PO inbox and set the default invoice acceptance channel to the provided billing address / procure email. Once we have the signed confirmation and bank letter, finance will enable ACH.

I'll draft the account creation steps:
1) Create payee record with legal name, EIN, mailing address.
2) Add alias field for invoice matching = "ApparaLedger Solutions".
3) Add contact: procure@apparaledger.com (PO inbox), AP contact: evan.torres@apparaledger.com (authorized signer).
4) Attach W-9 and bank verification to the record.

Grace — once you make the skeleton, set status to "pending ACH" and include Marissa as approver.
